nodes.label: Axioms for Physical Reasoning: Seiberg–Witten in Lean
nodes.author: Michael R. Douglas
nodes.rationale: Formalizes Seiberg–Witten solution in Lean 4 by postulating explicit physical postulates (H0–H7) and proving mathematical consequences. Demonstrates validation discipline for AI-generated physics results.

nodes.label: Two Kinds of Formalization
nodes.rationale: Mathematical physics: rigorous statement exists, prove it. Foundations for physical reasoning: codify non-rigorous reasoning community trusts where no proof within reach. Seiberg–Witten requires second kind.

nodes.label: Physical Postulates H0–H7
nodes.rationale: H0: carrier (N=2 SUSY + Coulomb-phase Higgsing). H1: special geometry. H2: BPS singularities. H3: monodromy from massless states. H4: electric–magnetic duality. H5: R-symmetry. H6: weak-coupling asymptotics. H7: spurionic covariance. Carried as predicates in theorem types, not global axioms.

nodes.label: Math ↔ Physics Dictionary
nodes.rationale: Each physical concept mapped to named mathematical object (PeriodBase, PeriodChart, special coordinates a/aD/τ, BPS central charge, charge lattice, symplectic reframing, etc.). Physics never enters silently; only through dictionary and named hypotheses.

nodes.label: Headline Theorems
nodes.rationale: SU(2) existence and uniqueness up to Γ(2) duality (sorry-free theorems). Curve has genus N−1, period matrix symmetric with Im τ ≻ 0. Singular at exactly u = ±Λ². Picard–Lefschetz monodromy symplectic. Modular function λ Γ(2)-invariant.

nodes.label: Mathematical Axioms (Classical)
nodes.rationale: Five named axioms at genus one: Γ(2) covering H/Γ(2) ∼= C\{0,1}, lift-uniqueness, two θ-identities (Jacobi triple product), Jacobi inversion. All classical, citable, textbook theorems deliberately kept as axioms.

nodes.label: Validation by Independent Agreement
nodes.rationale: Three tools: independent numerical oracle (278 checks at 30–40-digit precision), cross-model and self-review against pinned sources, validating transcriptions (Kodaira classification bridge). Physicist's triangle: weak-coupling, instanton expansion, exact periods agree.

nodes.label: Argyres–Douglas Points Worked Check
nodes.rationale: Axiom-free theorems: with Nf=1 at tuned point, curve factors as (x+Λ/2)³(x−3Λ/2), triple root (cusp). Pure SU(2) admits no triple root. NonLocalDegenerationLocus defined from data in hand, non-vacuous, witnessed by exact factorization.

nodes.label: Higher-Genus Mathematical Debt
nodes.rationale: Gauss–Manin / variation-of-Hodge-structure layer over moduli space behind consolidated periodRigidityAxiom. SU(N) skeleton runs on this single axiom. Constructing period geometry is future work (few weeks at genus 1, Mathlib-scale project for general SU(N)).

nodes.label: Prospects: Deriving Physical Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Three tiers: already within reach (BPS bound, Dirac–Schwinger–Zwanziger quantization), formalizable but needing infrastructure (special geometry, one-loop exactness, R-symmetry, family covariance), beyond reach (N=2 SYM existence as interacting theory).

nodes.label: Validation Discipline for AI-Generated Physics
nodes.rationale: Separate proved mathematical spine from physical hypotheses as named predicates. Residual trust localizes onto short list. #print axioms audits exactly which assumptions each result uses. Kernel exposes contradictions. Justifying axioms becomes finite, inspectable task.

nodes.label: Lean 4 Formalization Repository
nodes.rationale: Companion to ICML 2026 talk 'Validation of AI-generated results in theoretical physics'. Genus-one case in full; higher-genus SU(N) developed as axiomatized skeleton.
